changeSet.sql: create table wissens_export ( id uuid not null constraint wissens_export_pk primary key, status text not null constraint wissens_export_status_ck check (status in ('OFFEN', 'FERTIG', 'FEHLER')), benutzer text not null, rolle text not null, erstellt timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(), fertig timestamptz, s3_schluessel text, s3_version text, sha256 text constraint wissens_export_sha256_ck check (sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'), groesse bigint constraint wissens_export_groesse_ck check (groesse >= 0), fehler_id uuid, constraint wissens_export_fertig_ck check ((status = 'FERTIG') = (fertig is not null and s3_schluessel is not null and s3_version is not null and sha256 is not null and groesse is not null)) ); create index wissens_export_erstellt_ix on wissens_export (erstellt desc);
